pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: authz-unusual-rate spike detected on prod (svc-proxy) — ~2.4k 401s from 52.23.112.0/24 in last 5m. Pager routing to @aj-sre
maria-ops: seeing same on dashboards. Correlates to edge-proxy errors and higher latency for a subset of customers. Creating channel for triage.
aj-sre: oncall here, joining. Who has customer impact details?
sam-support: 3 customers reported degraded responses and repeated 401s. Ticket #12345 open. Support found copies of auth headers in staging-forwarder debug logs in s3://redwood-staging-debug/2026-03-18/ — need security confirm.
lee-security: high priority. If headers are in S3 assume potential token exposure until proven otherwise. Recommend immediate service account key rotation, revoke active session tokens, and WAF block src /24.
aj-sre: starting token revoke script now: `scripts/revoke_tokens.sh --filter src=52.23.112.0/24` — will post results.
aj-sre: revoke output: 128 sessions revoked, 0 errors.
maria-ops: applying temporary WAF rule + rate-limit on that IP range. ETA ~2m.
sam-support: CSMs notified; drafting customer note. Suggested neutral language: "auth anomaly detected; we applied mitigations and are investigating." Need legal review before send.
elaine-legal: pls avoid definitive wording like "leak" until we confirm exfil. Use "auth anomaly" or "suspicious activity" in customer comms. Preserve logs.
lee-security: starting CloudTrail + S3 access-log search for `s3:GetObject` and anomalous reads from that path since 2026-03-17. Will share findings.
aj-sre: spun a temporary fallback to a lower-capacity model variant for unaffected tenants to reduce load.
maria-ops: WAF rule is live; traffic from 52.23.112.0/24 is blocked. Auth failure counts down to baseline.
sam-support: one customer requested per-tenant key rotation — we performed targeted token revokes for their tenant. They asked for timeline updates.
lee-security: preliminary CloudTrail shows 6 GetObject calls from addresses in 52.23.112.0/24 at ~03:12 UTC to the staging debug prefix. Flagging for forensics team.
aj-sre: rotated prod svc-account keys involved in token signing, pushed updated KMS key, and deployed rollouts to all regions.
maria-ops: metrics confirm auth failure rate down ~99%. Latency normalized.
elaine-legal: do not delete suspect S3 objects. Place legal hold and preserve access logs for potential disclosure/regulatory review.
sam-support: updating tickets + CSM message queued with conservative wording. Customers acknowledged.
aj-sre: assembling timeline and evidence for post-incident writeup; will create GH issue and attach logs: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1933337777
lee-security: follow-ups: rotate debug-forwarder creds, audit any recent deploys that changed logging, and run integrity scans on pipeline. Scheduling postmortem within 48h.
maria-ops: handing off monitoring to night oncall @aj-sre. Runbook updated with steps taken.
aj-sre: I'll monitor for 4 hours, coordinate with security and support. Ping if anything new.
pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident acknowledged and contained. Containment timestamp 1933337790. Action items: postmortem in 48h, forensics report, customer timeline.
